summary.text: Steny Hoyer represents Maryland's 5th Congressional District in the U.S. House, to which he was first elected in a 1981 special election.

paragraphs.text: He served as House Majority Leader from 2007 to 2011 and 2019 to 2023, and as House Democratic Whip from 2003 to 2007 and 2013 to 2019.
Hoyer graduated from the University of Maryland in 1963 and Georgetown University Law Center in 1966, and in 1966 won a seat in the Maryland Senate, serving as its President from 1975 to 1978.
